name: companion
description: Companion: PCOS tracker and bilingual friend. frontend/ deploys to Vercel, backend/ to Render.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.api:types: npm --prefix backend run openapi && npm --prefix frontend run api:types
scripts.verify: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix frontend run check:locales && sh backend/scripts/check-secrets.sh
